title: Not what expected
text: Not what expected. This can is metal, but has a plastic insert. It was nice that it accepted standard 13 gallon bags, but the plastic insert getting smelly is the same problem I already have. There is an insert for odor but the second you open the can, the smell rushes out. This can also dented immediately, which is very upsetting for the cost. Someone needs to invent a better garbage can, the body should be metal, as should the lid --- it should not dent.
